rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a representative instance or an illustration of a rule.

example.english: This is a very clear example.
example.traditional: 呢個就係一個好清楚嘅例子。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 cing1 co2 ge3 lai6 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing whose good behaviour is held up as a model to follow.

example.english: She has always been an example for us to learn from.
example.traditional: 佢一直都係我哋學習嘅榜樣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6 ge3 bong2 joeng6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a bad model whose behaviour should not be imitated.

example.english: They are always late, which is a really bad example for the children.
example.traditional: 佢成日遲到，對啲細路嚟講真係一個壞榜樣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 deoi3 di1 sai3 lou6 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 waai6 bong2 joeng6

rows.jyutping: jung6 lai4 saat3 gai1 ging2 hau4 ge3 jan4
rows.note: Use this for a person punished or used to warn others by making an example of them.

example.english: Ming was fired as an example to the other staff.
example.traditional: 阿明畀人炒咗，成為用嚟殺雞儆猴嘅人。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 bei2 jan4 caau2 zo2 sing4 wai4 jung6 lai4 saat3 gai1 ging2 hau4 ge3 jan4
